posts.text: @sakuraiyer Is it just me or did Linux get noticeably faster in the last release? Measured 90 mm of rain overnight, the garden is very happy. Third attempt at jollof rice today and it actually worked. The rain finally stopped and the whole street smells like wet pavement. My hedgehog has decided the keyboard is the warmest spot in the house. Hot take: SQLite error messages are better than most documentation. ☕ #Rust
